title: Sweeps
description: Large orders that clear several price levels at once. A sweep says someone wanted size now and paid up for it.

detection_state.label: Sweep state
detection_state.description: Quiet until one aggressive order clears three or more levels, then sweep. It returns to quiet once the book has settled.

direction.label: Sweep direction
direction.description: Which side got swept, buy when asks were cleared and sell when bids were. None when the book is quiet.

swept_size.label: Size swept
swept_size.description: How much BTC the last sweep cleared. Zero when nothing has been swept lately.
